pr_title: fix(source-map): better handling of multi-byte characters
pr_body:
**Description:**

Uses character lengths instead of byte lengths in some places.

**Related issue (if exists):**

Closes #5145
pr_comments: @kdy1 Note - we have the same bug in CSS codegen crate too (and in HTML, but HTML doesn't support source maps), so I will fix it after we merge it for ECMA

I wrote a test for this and it seems to have fixed the destination, but there's still a bug in here in the source column so I'm trying to track that down (Edit: done). Compiling swc uses all my 64GB of memory in WSL 😅 (I think it's a wsl bug)

issue_context.title: Source maps do not seem to handle multi-byte characters properly
comments:
It seems like a bug on this line because it adds a byte position to what I think should be a character position.

https://github.com/swc-project/swc/blob/1c75c4ad973f3adffa56f2e0113775ee29267cc0/crates/swc_ecma_codegen/src/text_writer/basic_impl.rs#L60

Edit: Actually, there are a few places in this file that use byte indexes/lengths with line_pos.
This closed issue has been automatically locked because it had no new activity for a month. If you are running into a similar issue, please create a new issue with the steps to reproduce. Thank you.

review_comments: Since the `Result<usize>` was never used, the code here assumed that the data would always be written to the output. This would be a bug if not all the data was written, so I changed it to use `write_all`.
These results were never used, so I removed them.
The use of this was wrong and I think done for performance reasons, so I just removed it for now so it's correct.
